articles.summary: WINCHESTER, Va., October 20, 2026 – The executive leadership of Trex Company [NYSE: TREX], the world’s largest manufacturer of wood-alternative decking and railing, and a leading brand of high-performance, low-maintenance outdoor living products, will ring The Opening Bell® at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) today to commemorate the 30th anniversary of the company’s founding. The celebration recognizes three decades of innovation and growth that started with one category-defining invention and continues to redefine the future of outdoor living.
articles.title: Trex Company to Ring NYSE Opening Bell in Celebration of 30th Anniversary
